newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany sets tender for 5-yr Bobls -Buba.
newsitem.headline: Germany sets tender for 5-yr Bobls -Buba.

text.p: The German government on Tuesday set an auction of its Series 120 five-year Bobl bonds and simultaneously stopped selling the series as a tap issue to non-bank investors, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said.
Bids for the issue, which will carry a five percent coupon, will be accepted until 1000 GMT on November 27, the Bundesbank said. The pay date is November 29.
The issue will mature on August 20, 2001. Interest rate payments will start to accrue from August 20, 1996. The German securities number is WKN 114 120.
